rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Pop Pay is a fully local MCP server for managing AI agent payment security without SaaS or login requirements. Uses Chrome DevTools Protocol for credential injection and provides configurable spending guardrails — per-transaction and daily limits, allowed vendor categories, and keyword or LLM-based guardrail engines. Prevents AI agents from leaking payment card details or making unauthorized purchases.
